params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch renames local variables from camelCase starting with uppercase letters (e.g., X0, Y0, Z0, W0, rankx, ranky, rankz, rankw) to camelCase starting with lowercase letters (rankX, rankY, rankZ, rankW) or simplifies expressions by inlining variables (e.g., replacing X0 with (i - t) inline). These changes align variable names with the naming convention `^[a-z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$` and fix the SonarQube warning. The patch does not introduce unrelated changes such as adding or removing print statements or changing unrelated variable names arbitrarily. The changes are focused and minimal, only affecting the variable names and related expressions to comply with the naming convention.

Score: 3
